blocks.text: HAGONOY, Bulacan – The coastal Bulacan town of Hagonoy near the shores of Manila Bay, where tides continue to submerge almost all 26 barangays, has revived old pilapil (earth dikes or earth embankments) as flood walls in inner villages, a technique used by private fishpond owners in the previous decades. The project was first implemented in Barangay San Sebastian last year, part of efforts to tap traditional engineering technology to reduce high-saline floods brought in throughout the year by Manila Bay tides which have soaked down residences, inundated business and government properties and overwhelmed multiple hectares of fishponds.
